comment: Building-story tuning (docs/design/levelgen/gdd/building-stories.md F1 / F2 / F3 / F5; BUILDINGS_TECH_SPEC.md section 2). Read by Tools/TrainingGround/src/levelgen/buildingStories.ts and later by the C++ runtime. pick.budget[role] = the share of a role's buildings that get a story other than open (F3); pick.weights[role][story] = F1 step-2 weights (archetype dimension not used yet); pick.t_max = tries per building before it keeps 'open' (F5); pick.p_two = the chance a storied building gets a second, compatible story (F2). compatible[first] = stories that may follow `first` on the same building (pairs touching the same opening are left out: 3 + 10). detour_roles = the roles a detour story (4, 7) is eligible for (F1). rubble_escape_set_pieces = story 4's 'block, office' as generator set pieces (both are 'facade'). loud_front_states = front-door states that make story 9 eligible (designer 2026-11-19). gable_door_state[story] = the state that story gives a building's GABLE door(s) (an exterior ground door on a side that is neither the front door's side nor the opposite one; khrushchevka gable door, designer 2026-11-22): story 9 locks it - the quiet entry must be the broken back window, not a closed end door. A building without a gable door is unaffected. All values *proposal*.
